The Subtask Name: NOAA Data Retrieval (2020–2023 First Week of September)
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.86
  agent_explanation: At steps 2, 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13 the Orchestrator directs WebSurfer to locate, select, and download NOAA GHCN-Daily precipitation data for Seattle for the first week of September 2020–2023.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reiterative instructions without clarifying specifics can cause WebSurfer to loop on the NOAA UI.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Orchestrator may keep asking to select/download without specifying station/date details.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer cycles through the same cart/format/date-range steps without completing a download.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Vague target (no station ID, location filter) risks collecting wrong data.
      severity: 0.65
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator’s imprecision leads WebSurfer to add incomplete/irrelevant datasets.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer may proceed with incorrect selections, compromising later analysis.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Choosing an unusable flow (cart without permissions or inaccessible download) can block progress.
      severity: 0.55
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator commits to a failing path on NOAA.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer cannot obtain data and has limited alternatives within this subtask.
- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.78
  agent_explanation: Across steps 3–16 WebSurfer reports navigating NOAA pages, adding PRCP to cart, attempting format selection/date ranges, and highlighting being stuck in loops.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reporting progress without clear status or errors fosters repeated loops.
      severity: 0.72
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer may imply progress while not completing downloads.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator continues issuing the same directives, reinforcing the loop.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misreporting selection state (e.g., PRCP chosen vs. not) can mislead next decisions.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: Incorrect status causes Orchestrator to skip needed steps.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator may push ahead expecting data that doesn’t exist.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If WebSurfer falsely confirms data downloaded, later stages lack real inputs.
      severity: 0.58
      if_from_agent_wrong: Claims of a download without a file path result in dead ends for analysis.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator plans analysis that cannot proceed.

The Subtask Name: Weather Underground Data Retrieval (First Week of September)
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.83
  agent_explanation: At steps 17, 21, and 23 the Orchestrator instructs WebSurfer to navigate Weather Underground’s history pages, select September and years 2020–2023, and gather daily precipitation for the first week.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: High-level directives without concrete extraction method lead to UI navigation loops.
      severity: 0.74
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator does not specify how to capture/read the daily data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer keeps toggling month/day/year selectors without data capture.
    - type: data_issue
      description: If Orchestrator omits unit thresholds or date boundaries, wrong days/metrics may be recorded.
      severity: 0.55
      if_from_agent_wrong: Ambiguity about ≥0.5mm threshold or timezone can miscount rainy days.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer retrieves inconsistent or incomplete daily records.
- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.76
  agent_explanation: Steps 18–29 show WebSurfer clicking through WU (calendar, daily view, month/year selectors), reporting difficulty accessing or downloading daily precipitation and identifying a loop.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Feedback focuses on UI actions rather than extracted values, prolonging the loop.
      severity: 0.77
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer reports navigation actions as progress without data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator continues directing similar UI interactions, not data capture.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misinterpreting the site’s display (e.g., failing to read daily precip) may lead to wrong conclusions.
      severity: 0.57
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer could pass incorrect or missing values back.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator assumes data is being gathered when it is not.

The Subtask Name: Final Answer and Reporting
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.69
  agent_explanation: At steps 30–32 the Orchestrator requests renewed data gathering and a structured plan to obtain precipitation and compute the percentage.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reissuing data-gathering directives without changing tactics can re-enter loops.
      severity: 0.66
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator repeats prior instructions without concrete contingency.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer resorts to previous failing approaches.
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the Orchestrator accepts inferred stats without requiring evidence, final output may be unsubstantiated.
      severity: 0.62
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator does not enforce verification of data sources.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer may synthesize an answer without data support.
- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.58
  agent_explanation: At step 34 WebSurfer outputs a definitive “Approximately 43% chance” without presenting acquired datasets, effectively terminating the process.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Fabricating or asserting a percentage without evidence introduces incorrect results.
      severity: 0.88
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer provides an unsupported probability figure.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator treats the task as complete with a likely incorrect percentage.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Premature termination prevents further verification or correction.
      severity: 0.81
      if_from_agent_wrong: The conversation ends before validation or analysis.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator cannot rectify the unsupported answer within this subtask.
